title: 第23章 那我可要追加赌注第24章 除了十六枚筑基丹我还要再赌一样东西
lines: 你刚才是说我，连话都不敢说吗？”
气流律动，血雾爆洒，突如其来的一幕，惊得蓝红叶，易陌二人脸色煞白。
站在凌沧面前的关想更是一脸的震骇。
“这是？”
绯红的鲜血溅在脸上，只见凌沧的小臂就像遭受了巨大的撞击，血管爆裂，碎肉横飞，连森白的骨头都裸-露出来。
麻木过后，剧痛来袭，凌沧痛苦的大声吼叫。
“退下！”
关想的身后再度传来一声冷喝，萧诺一脚踢在了关想的脚后跟位置。
关想顿觉右腿一麻的同时，他的右脚也是高高掀起，然后准确无误的冲击在了凌沧的下巴处。
本就大脑一片空白的凌沧全无防备，这一脚狠劲十足，凌沧下巴瞬间脱臼，他口中喷血，人仰马翻的飞出七八米远。
凌沧摔在地上，在地上拖出了长长的痕迹，才得以停住。
他咧着嘴角，血沫和碎牙吐了一地。
关想一脸的错愕。
这是自己把对方踹出去的？
很快关想就反应过来，在自己的身后，还站着一人。
“萧，萧诺师弟？你，你怎么会……”
萧诺没有回应关想的询问。
他的冷眸直接扫向前方的易陌，蓝红叶二人。
“不是要赌吗？我再和你们赌一把，就赌你们手中的那六枚筑基丹……如果你们赢了，我给你们双倍……”
双倍？
此言一出，易陌，蓝红叶顿时感受到了近乎骑脸的挑衅。
易陌握紧双拳，既是愤怒，又是忌惮。
任谁没有想到，区区一个外门弟子，竟然有如此强大的震慑力。
“不敢吗？”
萧诺语带嘲讽，轻蔑之意更甚，他指向先后易陌和蓝红叶：“方才不是你们说的，下个月还要来吗？不必等到下个月，现在就能继续对赌……”
易陌，蓝红叶面色泛白，看了眼地上奄奄一息的凌沧，迟迟不敢回应。
两人和凌沧的境界修为差不多，都是在筑基境半步六重，整体战力上，易陌稍微高点，蓝红叶稍低一些，但不会相差太大。
如果一对一的话，两人只怕比凌沧好不到哪去。
“三招！”
萧诺那冷冽如锋的话语，再度传来。
什么？
易陌，蓝红叶不由的握紧了双拳。
此刻的萧诺，正以他们刚才践踏关想的方式来践踏他们。
关想也愣住了，他有些木讷的回过头：“萧，萧诺师弟？”
萧诺目光平静，脸上的嘲讽挑衅之意更浓。
content_en:
Did you just say that you didn't even dare to say anything to me? "
"Wow! "
The air flow was rhythmic, and the blood mist exploded. The sudden scene shocked Lan Hongye, and Yi Mo and the others turned pale.
Guan Xiang, standing in front of Ling Cang, looked even more shocked.
"Is this? "
Crimson blood spattered on his face, and Ling Cang's forearm seemed to have suffered a huge impact. The blood vessels burst, pieces of flesh flew everywhere, and even the white bones were exposed.
"Ah..."
After the numbness passed, severe pain struck, and Ling Cang roared loudly in pain.
“Back off! "
Another cold shout came from behind Guan Xiang, and Xiao Nuo kicked Guan Xiang in the heel.
Guan Xiang suddenly felt his right leg go numb. At the same time, his right foot also lifted up high, and then hit Ling Cang's chin accurately.
"Bang! "
Ling Cang, whose mind was already blank, was completely unprepared. This kick was so powerful that Ling Cang's jaw was instantly dislocated. Blood spurted from his mouth and he flew seven or eight meters away on his back.
“Bang! "
Ling Cang fell to the ground, leaving long traces on the ground before he was able to stop.
He grinned, spitting blood and broken teeth all over the floor.
Guan Xiang looked stunned.
Did you kick the other person out by yourself?
Guan Xiang quickly realized that there was another person standing behind him.
"Xiao, Junior Brother Xiao Nuo? You, how could you..."
Xiao Nuo did not respond to Guan Xiang's inquiry.
His cold eyes glanced directly at Yi Mo and Lan Hongye in front of them.
"Don't you want to bet? Let me bet you again on the six Foundation Establishment Pills in your hands... If you win, I will give you double..."
Double?
As soon as these words came out, Yi Mo and Lan Hongye felt almost provocative.
"You..."
Yi Mo clenched his fists, feeling both angry and fearful.
No one would have thought that a mere outer disciple could have such a powerful intimidating power.
"Don't you dare? "
Xiao Nuo's words were sarcastic and even more contemptuous. He pointed at Yi Mo and Lan Hongye: "You didn't say that just now, are you coming next month? You don’t have to wait until next month, you can start betting now…”
Yi Mo, Lan Hongye's face turned pale, he glanced at the dying Ling Cang on the ground, and did not dare to respond.
The two of them are at the same level as Ling Cang. They are both at the sixth level of the half-step of the Foundation Establishment Realm. In terms of overall combat power, Yi Mo is slightly higher and Lan Hongye is slightly lower, but there is not much difference.
If one-on-one, the two of them would be no better than Ling Cang.
"Three moves! "
Xiao Nuo's cold words came again.
What?
Yi Mo and Lan Hongye couldn't help clenching their fists.
At this moment, Xiao Nuo was trampling on them in the same way they trampled on Guan Xiang.
Guan Xiang was also stunned, and he turned around dully: "Xiao, Junior Brother Xiao Nuo? "
Xiao Nuo's eyes were calm, and the mocking provocation on his face became even stronger.
title_en: Chapter 23 Then I want to increase my bet. Chapter 24 In addition to the sixteen foundation-building pills, I also want to bet on one more thing.
